about_the_game:
Terraform Mars and bring it back to life in this solo survival crafting game. You are the last sentient being in the galaxy—a robot on a mission to mine, build, and revive a dead planet. Manage power, build a mobile colony, and uncover what happened to Earth.

TERRAFORM MARS

Turn a lifeless desert into a thriving ecosystem. Build powerful terraforming machines to raise atmospheric pressure, lower temperatures, generate soil, and plant vegetation. As conditions improve, incubate animals and bring life back to the red planet.

SURVIVE WITH POWER, NOT FOOD

As a robot, you don’t need food or oxygen—but you do need power. Lots of it. Harness Mars’ raw resources to generate energy, power your base, and stay operational. Manage your power carefully to survive and expand.

A COLONY ON WHEELS

Build modular rovers and take your base with you. Attach solar panels, power generators, storage units, and terraforming tools to create a fully mobile colony. Explore the planet with everything you need—right at your wheels.

SHAPE THE PLANET YOUR WAY

Mine minerals and rare metals, collect atmospheric elements, craft advanced components, and design custom structures anywhere on the surface. Build what you want, where you want—your creativity is the limit.

UNCOVER EARTH’S LOST HISTORY

Mars holds the forgotten legacy of humanity. Discover remnants of old colonies, investigate abandoned space stations, and uncover the mystery of how you became the galaxy’s last hope. The story of Earth’s fall—and your purpose—is waiting to be revealed.

short_description: You are a lone robot on a lifeless Mars. Gather resources, build machines, manage power, and terraform the planet to restore life. Explore, automate, and carry your colony on wheels as you reshape the planet- watching the world transform as you go.
